items.name: razorpay-checkout
items.title: Razorpay Checkout
items.description: A button that pays for the cart with Razorpay Standard Checkout, loaded on the first click, and confirms the order.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-payments and @payloadcms/plugin-ecommerce at the versions in this item's meta, add razorpayAdapter() to the ecommerce plugin, and render the button inside EcommerceProvider with razorpayAdapterClient(). See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/checkout

items.name: mips-payment-zone
items.title: mIPS payment zone
items.description: A button that pays for the cart with mIPS and shows its payment zone, running the zone's script.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-payments and @payloadcms/plugin-ecommerce at the versions in this item's meta, add mipsAdapter() to the ecommerce plugin, and render the payment zone inside EcommerceProvider with mipsAdapterClient(). Render mips-confirm-order on the page at the adapter's returnURL. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/checkout

items.name: mips-confirm-order
items.title: mIPS order confirmation
items.description: Confirms the order on the page that mIPS sends the customer back to after a payment.
items.docs: Render it inside EcommerceProvider on the page at mipsAdapter()'s returnURL, with the reference from the page's query string. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/checkout
